name: visual-regression-compare
description: Tool-agnostic image comparison for visual regression testing: pairs baseline and actual screenshots, runs a pluggable diff engine, applies limits, writes .actual and .diff files and a visual-regression-manifest run manifest. A CLI for folders of images and a library for test-runner adapters.
author: Jakub Freisler <jakub.freisler@frsource.org>

scripts.build: del-cli dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist && esbuild src/index.ts src/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=dist && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --packages=external --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/cli.js && node scripts/executable.mjs
